adaptations: Physical address loads replaced with owned integer data texture word reads; full-template binding is mandatory.
Original cut noise, finite-plank ray limits, twelve-step bevel iterations, normal and hit UV expressions retained; unit-scale arithmetic is unchanged.

Host XY resize stores positive scale in native unused GPU48 words40/44 (zero=1), scales sampling bounds and distance, and inverse-scales the ray metric. Original bevel constants/back cap are retained; nonuniform resize uses a conservative distance field rather than exact resized Euclidean distance. Arbitrary resize is a host adaptation, not a native behavior claim.
R8_SNORM samples transported as linear RGBA8 (signed sample+128), decoding after bilinear sampling.
Hit depth uses Engine MVP and forward-depth max rather than native reversed-depth min.
Recovered hit position is exported to existing building scene-lighting adapter.
scope: Ordinary wood full fragment transport; original .2/.3 depth shaders, gable consumer and full-scene parity not established.
